strongestPositiveAndRepairTest: Read the original 24 selected courses and screen the 151-course enriched workbook, blob c2bcc3b63ec7831fd0f7b8ddfb32de1260521655. Strongest positive: HCBPSYC314 covers attachment, childhood and personality across the lifespan; HCBPSYC212 includes disorders from infancy onwards; HCBPSYC312 explicitly includes child/adolescent assessment and psychotherapy, a stronger connection than the short cached description implies. MCCCOMM213 teaches didactic skills and actual design/delivery of public-speaking exercises with schoolchildren aged 9–12, including disadvantaged pupils. HCBPSYC315 creates evidence-based materials for youth leaders and educators in a school-culture/resilience project. HCBCOGN312 covers language acquisition, reading and dyslexia; methods courses support real empirical and synthesis skills. These are substantive contributions, not dismissed as incidental. However, the original programme remains organised around psychology/neuroscience and adult human biology rather than continuing inquiry into upbringing, family-school relationships, pedagogical theory, education design and related intervention/research. Tested bounded repairs add GOSPOLI312 public-policy analysis, GOSPHIL212 ethics, GOSLAWJ111 human rights, GOSSOCI111/214/311 social contexts, MCCCOMM111 as rhetoric foundation and GOSHIST311 boarding-school histories. Their actual content supplies general policy, ethical, social and historical inquiry, not an integrated academic study of parenting support or educational systems. Expanding one school project into a programme-wide claim or assuming a child-focused brief for a general research project would invent content. For the alternative Onderwijswetenschappen direction, school-based rhetoric, language learning and youth resilience remain real but do not supply sustained educational theory, school development or education-policy analysis. No defensible Alternative 1 established; later alternatives are not manufactured.

candidateAssessment.assessment: Strong developmental and child-clinical courses plus school/youth projects support parts of the field. A broader psychology programme cannot stand in for sustained upbringing, parent support and pedagogical-context intervention; bounded substitutions do not repair that gap.

candidateAssessment.assessment: MCCCOMM213 genuinely designs and delivers school exercises; HCBCOGN312 covers language acquisition and dyslexia; HCBPSYC315 works with educators. General sociology, policy and statistics complement these, but the combined catalogue does not establish a continuing programme in education theory, school development and educational-policy practice. Other-route interests are legitimate evidence for the generic target but do not change the neutral external-route choice.
